TITLE: You can't read with the corner of your eye?
NEXT: NEXT: A sausage floating between two fingers?

EN.가운데 노란 점만 보세요: Look only at the yellow dot in the middle
EN.눈을 옮기지 말고\n양옆 글자를 읽어 보세요:
Without moving your eyes,
try to read the words on both sides
EN.점만 보면서 양옆 글자는?: Eyes on the dot — what are the side words?
EN.눈은 가운데 그대로!: Keep your eyes in the middle!
EN.눈을 안 옮기면\n잘 안 읽히죠?:
Hard to read
without moving your eyes, right?
EN.눈 속 안쪽 벽(망막)을\n펼쳐 보면:
If we spread out the inner wall
of the eye (the retina)
EN.글자 · 색을 맡는 세포는\n한가운데에만 빽빽해요:
The cells for letters and color
are packed only in the very center
EN.가장자리는 어둠과\n움직임을 맡는 세포:
The edges have cells
for darkness and movement
EN.또렷하게 보이는 곳은\n팔 뻗은 엄지손톱만큼!:
The sharp spot is only as big as
your thumbnail at arm's length!
EN.그래서 눈은 1초에 몇 번씩\n휙휙 옮겨 다니며 읽어요:
So your eyes jump around
several times a second to read
EN.친구가 옆에서 색연필을\n천천히 앞으로 가져와요:
Have a friend slowly bring a colored pencil
in from the side
EN.움직임은 먼저, 색은 나중에\n알아채요:
You notice the movement first
and the color later
EN.평소엔 눈이 바쁘게 움직여서\n몰랐을 뿐!:
You never noticed
because your eyes are always busy moving!
